title: Pocketwire Pay in 4 Balances and Bank Payouts from a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Cross-product note of the credit risk team. When the owner of a Pocketwire Business Profile also holds a Pocketwire Pay in 4 account, the status and the amount owed recorded on that account decide the bank Pay in 4 keep-back.

**Rule.** The bank Pay in 4 keep-back is the whole amount owed on the owner's Pocketwire Pay in 4 account when that account is past due or suspended, 20 percent of the amount owed, rounded to the nearest cent, when the account is active and owes more than zero, and nothing when the owner has no such account or owes nothing on it; in any other case it is nothing.

| Owner's Pocketwire Pay in 4 account | Bank Pay in 4 keep-back |
|---|---|
| past due or suspended | the whole amount owed |
| active, amount owed above zero | 20 percent of the amount owed, to the nearest cent |
| active, nothing owed | none |
| no account | none |

**Cases (hypothetical accounts).** Active with USD 312.40 owed: USD 62.48. Suspended with USD 312.40 owed: USD 312.40.
